lines.en: My tusks go first.
I tramp the fallen leaves; the ground answers.
I know this originium forest.
Everywhere I walk, I leave pits.
I am heavier than a wild boar.
The crystals on me click as I move.
I walk the line of roots.
My snout turns up a layer of soil.
I shift along, unhurried.
I have rooted this stretch many times.
I shake the dirt off my head.
I crush through a thicket.
In the oriforest, I walk broad.
I stand by the originium growths, sniffing.
I am hunting a smell underground.
There is soil on my tusks.
It is quiet here.
I am grinding my teeth.
The crystals gleam on my back.
The originium fruits hang heavy on these trees.

lines.zh: 我拱出一个坑，又填回去。
lines.en: I root a hole, then fill it back.
I wait for whoever feeds me.
My smell is strong.
I lie still and listen to the roots below.
These originium growths are strange.
I sit down slowly.
The wind ruffles my bristles.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙一拱，源石林里的土松了。
lines.en: My tusks root up the soil of the originium forest.
My tusks can root up iron.
You carry the smell of originium dust.
You stand far off. I watch.
I am rooting over. Do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从后面摸。
lines.en: I do not like being touched from behind.
Have you fed me?

lines.zh: 我的獠牙不是给你看的。
lines.en: My tusks are not for show.
My tusks are aimed at you.
This body is solid.
You stepped in my rooting pit.
You are shorter than the last one.
You do not smell of originium.
I snort out a breath.
Are you afraid of me?
I am not calling. I am thinking.
I hold this wood.
Go if you must. I will not chase.
You are standing downwind.
I can smell the iron at your belt.
Stay a moment longer.
Half a step back, the soil packing.
My hide split open, and I'm still standing.
I grunt and pull back.
A corner of my crystal broke.
It hurts, and I can still butt.
I shake the blood off my tusks and hold.
Blood drips onto the originium.
I root up a mound for cover.
My tusks are here. I am still standing.
My bones jarred. I am still standing.
Is that iron?
I am not a picky eater.
Lower your hand so I can reach.
I am rooting over.

lines.zh: 这一把铁，塞不满我的牙缝。
lines.en: This handful of iron will not fill my teeth.
Iron rings between my teeth.
Throw another piece over.
Feed me and I follow you.
This iron still holds your warmth.
I wait. I will not ram you.
Drop it in the pit I rooted.
I sniff three times before eating.

lines.zh: 这一身硬皮，能挡十点伤害。
lines.en: This thick hide takes ten damage.
Done. I nudge you with my snout.
Keep your hand there. Do not shake.

lines.zh: 这味道，我用鼻子记下了。
lines.en: I have logged this smell in my snout.
One more feed and I am yours.
You hit my shoulder like a tree.
I shoved back.
I am all hard shell.
Mind the fierce pig's tusks.
Tusk on tusk — a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你这一下，撞得我肩头发麻。
lines.en: That blow numbed my shoulder.
Your feet slipped.
My tusk grazed you.
Move. I am rooting through.
Ram again. I do not mind.
I root up a patch of soil for it.
It has fewer crystals than I.
We root side by side.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够养活我们。
lines.en: This wood can feed us both.
I root the firmest soil over to it.
It lies down first.
I do not take its food.
Something is moving at night.
I keep to the outer ring.
At dawn we walk together.
I root up what is on the ground.
This one is edible.
These tusks can crack bone.

lines.zh: 这獠牙是用来掘矿的，不是嚼草的。
lines.en: These tusks are for digging ore, not chewing grass.
It is stuck between my teeth.
I root it under the tree roots.
This iron chunk belongs in my rooting pit.
Wrong smell. I spat it out.
Not eating it. Tossed.
I want this one.
Something is ahead.
I heard the thud in the soil.
That smell is wrong.
My tusks point that way.

lines.zh: 源石森林里，我嗅到你了。
lines.en: In the oriforest, I caught your scent.
My forest line ends here.
It has come in.

lines.zh: 源石在皮下鼓起来，我准备好。
lines.en: Originium swells under my hide. I'm ready.

lines.zh: 我这对獠牙，撞得动石头。
lines.en: These tusks can move stone.

lines.zh: 一百七十点血，我不怕撞。
lines.en: A hundred seventy health — I don't fear a charge.
My hooves pack the soil down.

lines.zh: 我这对獠牙，长在源石林里。
lines.en: My tusks grew in the originium woods.
My snout is working.
I have trenched the ground.
It has no way back, and neither do I.
I dip my tusks low.
Tusks angled up.
Two more steps and I charge.
Tusks up.
Ram.
I lunge, tusks first.
It is flipped over.
Feed me iron and I grow stronger.
My butt shattered a stone.
My own crystal cracked.
It rolls into the brush.
A flick of my tusks and you are airborne.
Blood mixed with soil.
I stop and pant.

lines.zh: 够了，源石獠牙已经磨好。
lines.en: Enough; my Originium tusks are honed.
I come out of the originium wood.
The soil is rooted open.
The smell here is strange.
I shake the originium dust off.
First I root a circle.
The crystals shine in the dark.
I can stay in this wood.

lines.zh: 我这副獠牙，是吃铁长出来的。
lines.en: These tusks grew from eating iron.
My tusks are meaner than a boar's.
I lower my head and look at you.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire singed a patch of my bristles.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的重量全压在自己身上。
lines.en: I fall and all my weight lands on me.
Water fills my snout and I shake hard.
The blast throws a layer of soil over me.
An arrow lodges in the crystal on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股力压得我抬不起头。
lines.en: This force holds my head down.
Too hungry to root.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我整只僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No soil below. I keep falling.
